Definition: Amasai, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Amasai = "burdensome"; 1) a warrior and chief of the captains of Judah and Benjamin who joined David at Ziklag; 2) a Kohathite Levite, father of Mahath and ancestor of Samuel; 3) a priest who blew the trumpet before the ark; 4) another Kohathite Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah
